title: MyCloud Mobile Pro
summary: MyCloud Mobile Pro brings calls and texts to your mobile device.
description: MyCloud Mobile Pro is a SIP soft client that extends VolP functionality beyond the landline or desktop. It brings features of the MyCloud UCaaS platform, such as calling and texting directly to end user's mobile devices as a Unified Communications solution. With MyCloud Mobile Pro, users can maintain the same identity when making or receiving calls and text from any location, regardless of their device. MyCloud Mobile Pro has been engineered with enhanced push notification technology to save battery life.
